// 2026-09-10 用户拍板：标题左边那个对勾删掉。标题是一句问句，前面顶着 ✓ 读起来像「已经切好了」。
collects: '✓ 匿名分享：用了哪些功能 · 生成成没成功 · 失败属于哪一类 · Agent 每一步用了什么工具、花了多久',
collects: '✓ Shared anonymously: which features you used · whether a generation succeeded · which category a failure falls into · which tools each Agent step used and how long it took',
leftSection={shareCopied ? <IconCheck size={15} stroke={1.8} aria-hidden="true" /> : <IconCopy size={15} stroke={1.8} aria-hidden="true" />}
{allPassed ? <IconCheck size={19} stroke={2} /> : terminal ? <IconAlertTriangle size={18} stroke={1.8} /> : <NomiLoadingMark size={18} />}

{copied ? <IconCheck size={15} stroke={1.8} aria-hidden="true" /> : <IconCopy size={15} stroke={1.7} aria-hidden="true" />}
return <IconCircleCheck size={16} stroke={1.7} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-workbench-success-ink" aria-hidden="true" />
